title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19422 cSS injection was possible in Mermaid diagrams via configuration directives…
description: A low-severity CSS injection vulnerability exists in JetBrains YouTrack versions before 2026.2.19422. The issue occurs via configuration directives in Mermaid diagrams, potentially allowing injection of CSS code. No known exploits are reported in the wild, and the vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or availability but may affect integrity. No patch information is provided in the available data.
